observed_problem: Machine checkpoints could be marked passed from handler output shape/path/SHA without implementation-controlled semantic validation of the exact artifacts.
expected_behavior: A machine checkpoint becomes passed only after the configured implementation-controlled validator accepts the exact outputs and an immutable validation attestation is pinned in Production State.
actual_behavior: Handler success was sufficient to advance checkpoints, allowing semantically invalid synthetic Architecture bytes to reach Architecture Review.
improvement_action: Separate handlers from semantic validators; require exact-byte Validation Attestations and State-pinned checkpoint provenance before lifecycle advancement or Human Gate use.
